Method of Attack: Loading arbitrary JavaScript in the context of logged-in Zimbra webmail sessions
Exfiltrating cookies for persistent mailbox access
Sending phishing messages to user's contacts
Prompting download of malware from trusted websites
Impacted Systems: Zimbra email and collaboration platform versions 8.8.15 P29 and P30
Attack Vector: Spear-phishing emails with malicious links targeting logged-in Zimbra webmail users
Indicators of Compromise: Specific URI format on targeted Zimbra webmail hosts
Domains and IP addresses linked to the EmailThief campaign (as per Volexity report)
